_about: Parity pass 2, lane E (2026-10-10): the PA announce drain lifted from the reference install - the queue, the line log, the overflow card, the plain-sentence rewrite, the speech hygiene - with krew_announce.py as the one seam (the reference install played the line on its own audio stack; krew hands it to the Wall's player, POST /v1/announce).

announce-drain.about: crew/scripts/krew-announce-drain.py + its unit (long-running, opt-in by --enable announce-drain): one line at a time from the announce queue, a roundup when more than 3 wait, more than 5 dropped in an hour files one card. Every line is logged to <inbox>/announcer/ (the Daily's announcer row reads it).

improve-nnt.about: The improvement round's NNT source, lifted from the reference install: nnt-repos.py (the week's repos from the video descriptions, called by steward-architect-run.sh research) and nnt-seen.py (the seen store team-eval-rank.py reads; without it the ranker says the store is off, once).
